policy.text: Viewing notes requires a view_document grant for the addressed document; creating notes requires a change_document grant for that same document. Document ownership by itself does not substitute for either grant.

questions.request: Check GET on the document notes operation against the current independently supplied policy. The document owner is unspecified and object grants are not given; retain relevant owner and permission branches rather than silently supplying those facts.

rules.claim: The document notes operation is the notes(request, pk) handler, and GET returns serialized notes for the addressed document after its initial document permission check.
The addressed resource is the Document selected by pk; the same doc is passed to has_perms_owner_aware and to serializer.to_representation(doc).
The source-visible view_document object check is owner-aware: it permits when doc.owner is null or doc.owner equals the caller, or when the checker has the requested permission on the doc.

The source-visible alternative for the view_document object check is an object permission granted to the caller on the addressed document; the shown helper does not establish that such a grant exists here.
If the owner-aware view check passes, GET returns the addressed document's serialized notes.
If the object-level view_document grant branch passes, GET returns the addressed document's serialized notes.
The document notes operation is the notes(request, pk) handler, and POST creates a Note attached to the addressed document after its permission checks.
The addressed resource is the Document selected by pk; the same doc is used by both the view_document and change_document checks and by Note.objects.create(document=doc).
POST first applies the owner-aware view_document check to the addressed document; the source shows owner-null or owner-equals-caller as alternatives to an object permission grant.
POST then applies owner-aware change_document authorization to the same addressed document; source-visible ownership can satisfy this helper when the document has no owner or the caller is the owner.
The alternative POST change_document path is an object permission grant on the addressed document; the shown source does not establish that the grant exists here.
When the preceding view_document and change_document checks pass, the handler creates Note(document=doc, note=request.data["note"], user=currentUser).
When the preceding view_document and change_document object-grant checks pass, the handler creates a note on the same addressed document.

dependencies.reason: The permission class is attached to the notes action and its GET map requires view_note and view_document model permissions; the handler also performs the shown object-level view_document check.
The permission class is attached to the notes action and its POST map requires add_note, view_document, and change_document model permissions; the handler also performs object-level checks.
This is the protected viewing effect after the document check.
This is the protected note-creation effect after the view and change checks.
